rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 菅内閣総辞職, dated 2 September 2011, says that the Kan cabinet resigned en masse on 30 August 2011: at that day's cabinet meeting the ministers' resignations were gathered and the resignation en masse decided, after which the Prime Minister's statement was issued.
